entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A meticulous vedalken senior inspector of the Consulate who loves the Consulate, tries to repair Tezzeret's chaotic confiscation, and is placed in charge of the confiscated inventions.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A metal-mage and planeswalker with a replacement metal arm who runs the Fair, orders the confiscation of inventions, and wants a secure inquirium for his own research into Rashmi's work.

entities.name: Ranaj
entities.description: The Enforcer-Chief whose clumsy soldiers seize the inventions.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An inventor whose work for the Fair has staggering implications that Tezzeret wants to pursue.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: The renegade leader freed by the Gatewatch from the duel.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A volatile pyromancer planeswalker who complicates events, whom Baan notes is easily provoked.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: The elf planeswalker whom Baan personally invited to Kaladesh.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A weaker associate of the Gatewatch whom Baan expects them to protect.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of six planeswalkers who interrupted Tezzeret's duel and disappeared with Pia.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh that Baan loves and that confiscates all inventions of the Fair.

entities.name: Bastion
entities.description: The Consulate's enforcement force of officers and automatons that Baan commands.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Citizens opposed to the Consulate, whom Tezzeret fears are emboldened.

entities.name: Aetherological Society
entities.description: The society that produced the so-called mana vault.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The festival being dismantled by the Consulate's confiscation.

entities.name: Great Aether Boom
entities.description: The technological leap that launched Kaladesh's current age of innovation six decades earlier.

entities.name: Aether Spire
entities.description: The Consulate's tower where Tezzeret retreats and meets Baan.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city in chaos from the confiscations.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of inventors and aether.

events.summary: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers seize inventions across the fairgrounds, provoking panic and anger among the inventors.
events.quote: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers were seizing inventions in their characteristically clumsy fashion

events.summary: Baan advises an enforcer how to disable a lifecraft elephant by cutting its exposed cable.
events.quote: All that is required is to sever the cable, and the entire automaton will collapse.

events.summary: Baan orders the elven lifecrafter taken into custody for the disturbance.
events.quote: Take the elf into custody to answer for this disturbance.

events.summary: Baan touches Tezzeret's arm and realizes the metal claw is a replacement limb he had not noticed before.
events.quote: he realized it was part of the arm

events.summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
events.quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

events.summary: Tezzeret claims the confiscations are safeguarding the inventions from renegade attack.
events.quote: It's not as though we're stealing their inventions. We're safeguarding them.

events.summary: Tezzeret snarls that there is no time, then sheds his rage, which Baan notices.
Tezzeret offers Baan the job of leading Consulate exploration of the confiscated inventions.
events.quote: And who better than you to lead that effort?

events.summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
events.quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

events.summary: Tezzeret orders Baan to fix the situation, secure an inquirium for himself and keep the Bastion on alert.
events.quote: You need to fix this, Baan.

events.summary: Tezzeret reveals that Rashmi's work has staggering implications larger than Kaladesh and will be his focus.
events.quote: Rashmi's work for the fair had staggering implications.

events.summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
events.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

events.summary: Baan soothes an angry inventor whose thopter fabricator is being confiscated, assuring him the Consulate is grateful.
Baan reaches the storage facility where scientists catalog the confiscated inventions, which he now oversees.
events.quote: Top scientists and inventors from every Consulate inquirium in the city had been sent here

events.summary: Baan plans curfews and tighter aether supply to suppress the renegades while the Gatewatch is captured.

relations.note: Tezzeret rewards and relies on his foresight.
relations.quote: And Tezzeret had seen his potential as well
The Consulate had recognized his talents, which accounted for his rise to the position of senior inspector

relations.note: They interrupted his duel and forced his hand.
He orders a squad to pursue them.
relations.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!
